note: A SEPARABILITY PROBE, not a ratified oracle. Built 2026-07-28 to answer one question: is the non-separability found on US5447630A (D53) a property of that patent, or of narrow-vocabulary single-document corpora generally? Every answerable item names a topic the patent discusses repeatedly (verified by term counts); every content-absent item names a topic with ZERO mentions (verified the same way), so 'absent' is a checked fact rather than an intuition. NOT ratified and NOT frozen: it exists to fit a floor, not to grade answers.
